title: H8: HTTP mapping and body cap
description: Every decodable protocol result -> 200 with body; undecodable -> 400; room not hosted -> 404; oversized -> 413; notify -> 201 (spec). Content-Type application/octet-stream (no media type registered, .5.33). MAX_BODY_LEN = 4 MiB, INVENTED, NOT FROM SPEC. From header required and parsed, used only for envelope consistency. Chosen (plan recommendation approved by Mark 2026-10-18).
